				[b]Note:[/b] By default, if the node comes from an instantiated scene saved on disk, the original child structure will be used for the copy. If the structure has been modified at runtime, this can result in properties being set with the wrong values. In such cases, use this method without [constant DUPLICATE_USE_INSTANTIATION].
